One OAuth client in your Google Cloud project lets each person connect their Google account: Gmail, Calendar, Search Console and Analytics, read only. Sign in with Google is a separate client, below.

**Used by:** [OpenSEO](/docs/apps/openseo) for Search Console and Google Analytics (the `identity`, `search-console.read` and `analytics.read` sets); [OpenCRM](/docs/apps/crm) for Gmail and Google Calendar (the `gmail.read` and `calendar.read` sets).

## Connect accounts

Each person connects their own Google account in the Gateway, once, and every app that asks uses it. Apps never see the tokens. [How connecting works](/docs/connect-oauth)

The redirect URI to register, with your Gateway's address (like `apps.example.com`):

```text
https://<your gateway>/connect/google-workspace/callback
```

1. Signed in to Google, [create a Cloud project](https://console.cloud.google.com/projectcreate) (for example `EveryApp`). With Google Workspace, put it in your organization.
2. Enable the APIs your apps use: for OpenSEO, the [Search Console API](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/library/searchconsole.googleapis.com), the [Analytics Admin API](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/library/analyticsadmin.googleapis.com) and the [Analytics Data API](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/library/analyticsdata.googleapis.com); for OpenCRM, the Gmail API and the Google Calendar API.
3. Set up the [consent screen](https://console.cloud.google.com/auth/overview): an app name people will see, a support email, and the audience: **Internal** (your Workspace only, no review) or **External**.
4. On [Data Access](https://console.cloud.google.com/auth/scopes), add only the scopes your apps use: `webmasters.readonly` and `analytics.readonly` for OpenSEO, `gmail.readonly` and `calendar.readonly` for OpenCRM.
5. [Create a client](https://console.cloud.google.com/auth/clients): type **Web application**, and under **Authorized redirect URIs** add the redirect URI above. Copy the **Client ID** and **Client secret**, or select **Download JSON**.
6. **External** only: while the app is in Testing, add each person under **Audience → Test users**. Their access expires every 7 days until Google verifies the app.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the client ID and secret:

```bash
everyapp provider add google-workspace
```

Or add it in **Manage workspace → Providers**.

### Use it in an app

```ts
capabilities: {
  "google-workspace": { access: "read", scopes: ["gmail.read"], why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

Apps ask for these scope sets:

| Set | Allows | Provider scopes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `identity` | Google account (who you are) | `openid`, `email`, `profile` |
| `gmail.read` | Gmail (read-only) | `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly` |
| `calendar.read` | Google Calendar (read-only) | `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.readonly` |
| `search-console.read` | Search Console (read-only) | `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters.readonly` |
| `analytics.read` | Google Analytics (read-only) | `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/analytics.readonly` |

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show google-workspace` shows the client as set. Then open the account menu → **Connected accounts** → **Connect Google**.

## Sign in with Google

Adds **Continue with Google** to your Gateway's sign-in page, for people you've invited. [Sign-in](/docs/sign-in)

1. Open [console.cloud.google.com](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials) and create an OAuth client ID (Web application).
2. Add the redirect URL `https://<your gateway>/api/auth/callback/google`.
3. Copy:
   - `GOOGLE_SIGNIN_CLIENT_ID`: The OAuth client's Client ID (ends in .apps.googleusercontent.com)
   - `GOOGLE_SIGNIN_CLIENT_SECRET`: The OAuth client's Client secret.

- An OAuth consent screen still in Testing only signs in the test users listed on it; publish it for everyone else.

Turn it on. It asks for each value:

```bash
everyapp signin add google
```

**Check it worked:** `everyapp signin show google` shows each setting as set. Then sign out and select the button.
